import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, reverse;
        long capacity;
        
        Edge(int to, int reverse, long capacity) {
            this.to = to;
            this.reverse = reverse;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }
    
    static class FlowGraph {
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        int[] level, iter;
        int source, sink;
        
        FlowGraph(int nodes, int s, int t) {
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[nodes];
            iter = new int[nodes];
            source = s;
            sink = t;
        }
        
        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), cap));
            graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }
        
        boolean buildLevel() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[source] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }
        
        long augment(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink) return flow;
            for (int i = iter[u]; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                iter[u] = i;
                Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    long pushed = augment(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.capacity -= pushed;
                        graph.get(e.to).get(e.reverse).capacity += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long dinic() {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevel()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = augment(source, (long)1e18)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        String[] grid = new String[n];
        int zy = -1, zx = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zy = i;
                    zx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        br.readLine();
        br.readLine();
        
        String[] exits = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            exits[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> bfsQ = new LinkedList<>();
        bfsQ.offer(new int[]{zy, zx});
        dist[zy][zx] = 0;
        
        int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
        int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
        
        while (!bfsQ.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfsQ.poll();
            int y = cell[0];
            int x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                if (dist[ny][nx] != -1 || grid[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y') continue;
                dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
                if (dist[ny][nx] < T) {
                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = T;
                    else dist[i][j] = Math.min(dist[i][j], T);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[][] nodeId = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(nodeId[i], -1);
        }
        int nodeCount = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    nodeId[i][j] = nodeCount++;
                }
                c = exits[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    nodeId[i][j] = nodeCount++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int src = 0, dst = nodeCount + 1;
        FlowGraph flow = new FlowGraph(nodeCount + 2, src, dst);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = grid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(src, nodeId[i][j], c - '0');
                }
                
                c = exits[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    flow.addEdge(nodeId[i][j], dst, c - '0');
                }
                
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dy[d];
                    int nj = j + dx[d];
                    if (ni < 0 || ni >= n || nj < 0 || nj >= n) continue;
                    if (grid[ni].charAt(nj) == 'Y' || grid[ni].charAt(nj) == 'Z') continue;
                    
                    if (nodeId[i][j] != -1 && nodeId[ni][nj] != -1) {
                        flow.addEdge(nodeId[i][j], nodeId[ni][nj], 1000000000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(flow.dinic());
    }
}
